tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: No respiratory viral pathogens detected by nucleic acid amplification in the tested specimen. These results suggest that common respiratory viruses, including influenza, RSV, parainfluenza, rhinovirus, metapneumovirus, and adenovirus, are not present at the time of testing. Correlate with clinical findings and consider other causes if symptoms persist.
